subject: design/implement-now-authenticated-review-obligations
statement: One closed `routing-activation-proof/v2` manifest is committed on main before activation. It pins the exact candidate mainline object; compatible demand, native-policy, routing-evidence, implementation executor, review-state, impl-review process/persistence, event, driver-consumer, and adapter generations; effective catalog/qualification digests; both configured evidence-ref heads and every relied-on event ID/digest, including the EVT-13↔EVT-17 schema pair; conformance/abuse/crash/dogfood/DoD evidence digests; operator qualification and release signatures; fallback/invalidation drill results; and a retired-path reachability report. Unknown, missing, stale, incompatible, unsigned, non-mainline, or cross-generation input invalidates the whole manifest.
